tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Start a free email+password account. Returns pending_verification. No API key until the email is verified. Verification mail may not be delivered yet — finish verification from the dashboard when mail is available. Then connect with OAuth or an API key. Never paste permanent secrets into chat.

tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: Create one short link. Returns state, URLs when active, qr_tracking_url. Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: shorten_urls
tools.description: Create up to 100 short links in one sync batch. Correlate with client_ref. Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Fetch one link by id (owner-scoped when authenticated). Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: resolve_short_url
tools.description: Resolve a short URL or code to status; destination only if active. Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: create_qr
tools.description: Owner-only: return qr_tracking_url, PNG image content, and resource links to GET /v1/links/{id}/qr (PNG+SVG). Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: List short links owned by the authenticated account (paginated). Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: get_link_analytics
tools.description: Human-adjusted click analytics for a link you own (countries, devices, referrers, QR-tagged visits). Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Update a link you own (destination). Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

tools.name: disable_link
tools.description: Disable a link you own (soft-disable; destination withheld). Tool call requires a registered account (Bearer or OAuth).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
